title: Association-style initiate then Cancel-Response-PDU
purpose: Provide a more realistic association-to-MMS progression by sending an ACSE/UserInformation-shaped initiate frame before a server-to-client Cancel-Response-PDU, increasing direction and state diversity beyond isolated single-PDU seeds.
expected_behavior: The first frame should drive association/initiate-oriented decoding through the documented ACSE/UserInformation layered presentation and MMS initiate tag coverage. The second frame should exercise Cancel-Response-PDU parsing as a server-originated MMS PDU without relying on an identical single-frame cosmetic variant.
constraints_preserved: TPKT total-length fields are consistent with the complete message.
Layer order remains compatible with TPKT/COTP and documented ACSE/UserInformation presentation.
Directionality is diversified with a client-to-server setup message followed by a server-to-client MMS response.
Only conservative model-prior completion is used for minimal initiate embedding.
issue_safety_notes: No malformed TPDU-size parameter, no copied crash trigger, and no oversized BER length or octet-string allocation analogue. This seed is intended as a valid/stateful parser-path expansion.
